hypothetical_combined_allocation_constra: An explicit reviewed sequencing decision is required before reserving/releasing GPU resources without already accepted matched receiver/paired evidence. Keeping the same cap alone is not that decision.

If such a decision were made, finish data-only profiling first, obtain honest completed measurement and conservative resource acceptance, then create the original immutable pilot admission/reservation/mapping for the first time before production pilot entry. Do not mutate a previous original admission or mint/use a partial authority context.

The diagnostic prephase would need separately reviewed orchestration that truthfully accepts a GPU-resourced allocation. Do not falsify GPU TRES/visibility or reuse a CPU-only supervisor by clearing its GPU checks. The data-only record model_loaded/execution_authorized false does not mean no GPUs were allocated or billed.

Same allocation can address CPU family/job-local mount applicability only if actual measurement and consumer software/storage/resource/cgroup contexts match. No automatic match follows from same node or same job.

Accepted profiling cold+repeat each perform three target read/hash passes; subsequent unchanged production pilot performs its own two-read entry and later final witness. The accepted adapter releases both profiled results and cannot supply a loader-minted authority handle. Budget at least those nine logical target passes and three parse/freeze entries for this combined prefit path, plus guards/model/numerical/terminal work. Do not count profiling as the actual production entry.

Preserve the original wrapper/allocation start and minimum initial/current deadline across all phases and any process transitions. Waiting for root validation/publication, profiling reads, imports, actual production reload, authority/handle proof, model load and all terminal work consume the same GPU allocation window.

Direction M1 is a total0.5GPUh/1800s PAIR, not a fresh allowance for initial measurement+prefit. Reserved GPU-hours are charged regardless of actual underuse/status; there is no automatic refund. Reserving the entire pair for the first diagnostic/prefit job leaves no later reservation room for selected timing.

Selected timing has its real M2 capture/fit/validation/complete-selection dependency and a different inventory/reservation scope. Do not assume the initial allocation can also cover that later part or retarget its immutable reservation to another inventory.

If measurement, bounds, original numerical gates, paired feasibility or remaining-lease checks fail, model access remains prohibited. Any spent/failed reservation remains charged under original rules; no retry, new reservation ceiling or skipped control is authorized.

Authentic handle/full-final-barrier accounting and unchanged full-target/M2 capacity tiers remain obligations. Sampling alone is not an upper bound; do not guess or shrink resource fields to manufacture admission.
